When the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is applied to the allied field of play.

Never misses. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Grants the following effect [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="time" P="times" ]:
Lowers one of the target’s following stats by one stat rank at random: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness. Turns the field of play’s zone into an [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ]. (An [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] powers up [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ]-type attacks.) Increases the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ].
